purpose: library: binary search — the halving procedure over a sorted array stated as ordered steps, run time O(ln n), the overflow-safe middle-index formula (mid = low + (high - low)/2 versus the overflow-prone mid = (high + low)/2), and its behavior on an ordered linked list (O(n) traversals but O(log n) comparisons, like linear search). Fits step ordering of the search procedure, quiz cards on the formulas and complexity, and a compare table of binary versus linear search.
